items.title: Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I just want to be as helpful to other musicians as Art Blakey was to me, as Elvin was to me, as Freddie Hubbard was to me, Eddie Harris, Stanley Turrentine, all these guys were very available

ctx.x: Well I tell you what, I feel that in Art’s honor I want to try to help as many people as I can because I know that’s what he was doing. He wanted to help musicians and I know

that one thing he always told me is don’t put another musician down because if you put another musician down you’re putting yourself down. So I try to, obviously in my recesses we make more judgments about people than we probably should, but I always feel that I should start off with something positive to say about any artist or any musician. Find something positive. Because there really is something there that’s positive. We just choose to look at the negative aspect of it, but everyone doing something has some…
All right. Well said. On that note, I’ll get you to your next engagement. And thanks for your time.
